mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 2% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6%, it signals a supply-driven economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO YoY decline > 2% and UNRATE > 6% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and rising by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and rising > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% year-over-year signals a weakening housing market and consumer spending, which will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST YoY decline > 10% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) declines for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS declines for 2 consecutive months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 3% year-over-year and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3%, it signals a high-inflation environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY rise > 3% and FEDFUNDS > 3% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) rising by more than 5% year-over-year signals strong consumer demand that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS YoY growth > 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.
